findings.title: Materials' 120% growth bet is extreme
findings.body: Materials trades at 17.24x forward but 37.86x trailing, a 54 percent compression that assumes earnings nearly double. That puts the trailing multiple at the 91st percentile while the forward multiple sits at the 38th, a 52-point gap — the widest in the table and a bet on a margin recovery that has not yet shown up.

findings.title: Health Care's 84% growth is priced in
findings.body: Health Care's forward and trailing multiples both sit at the 75th percentile, yet the forward lens is 46 percent cheaper. That compression implies 84 percent earnings growth next year, an unusually aggressive assumption for a sector whose valuation has not moved lower in five years.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' percentile gap signals distress
findings.body: Consumer Staples' trailing P/E is at the 82nd percentile while the forward multiple is at the 24th, a 58-point gap. The 30 percent compression implies 44 percent earnings growth, but the one-week 14-point drop in forward percentile suggests analysts are rapidly losing confidence in that recovery.
